# ASG SHOP - Q3 2026 Performance Report

Quarterly analytics and infrastructure review for Apars Classroom (ASG SHOP). Period: **Jul 1 – Sep 30, 2026**. Canonical page: https://stats.asgshop.ai/2026/q3/  
Author: Md Maheyan Islam, Chief Technology Officer, ASG SHOP (cto@asgshop.ai). Previous reports: Q2 https://stats.asgshop.ai/2026/q2/ · Q1 https://stats.asgshop.ai/2026/q1/

Sources: Pulse Engine (Google Analytics 4), Google Search Console, Apars CDN edge statistics, Apars Media Portal usage reports. Machine-readable dataset: q3data.json. Index for language models: llms.txt.

## Summary

The Admission 2026 cycle arrived in mid-August and reset every ceiling on the platform: active students nearly doubled quarter over quarter, live classes crossed 300,000 participants, and the edge delivered its heaviest quarter yet. September 2026 was the largest delivery month in the platform's history (648 TB).

## Headline KPIs (Q3 2026 vs Q2 2026)

| Metric | Q2 2026 | Q3 2026 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active students | 639K | 1,191,900 | +86.5% |
| New students | 744K | 1,365,732 | +83.6% |
| Total events | 70.8M | 101,852,791 | +43.9% |
| Avg engagement per active student | 18m 56s | 57m 05s (3425 s) | ×3.0 |
| CDN bandwidth delivered | 1.06 PB | 1.313 PB | +23.9% |
| CDN requests | 1.82B | 1.970B | +8.2% |
| Rolling 30-day active students (peak) | 299K (Jun 30) | 608,723 (Sep 9) | +103.6% |
| Live class sessions / participants | - | 917 / 311,224 | new section |

## 01 - Student Analytics (Pulse Engine / GA4)

- Active students: 1,191,900; new students: 1,365,732; total events: 101,852,791 (~85 per active student).
- Average engagement time per active student: 57m 05s.
- Rolling 30-day active students: opened at 299,419 (Jul 1), peaked at 608,723 on Sep 9, closed at 532,427 (Sep 30). The inflection began Aug 13; the 30-day window first exceeded 500K on Aug 24.
- Rolling 7-day active peak: 224,085 on Aug 20. Daily active peak: 62,033 on Sep 1; July low 23,843 (Jul 20).
- Stickiness peaks: DAU/MAU 15.1% (Aug 15; Q2 18.4%), WAU/MAU 48.3% (Aug 18; Q2 55.4%), DAU/WAU 33.4% (Aug 15; Q2 36.3%). Ratios compressed because the denominator (monthly base) grew faster than daily habit.

## 03 - Acquisition & Audience

### Arrival channels (first-touch source/medium, share of active students)

- Direct: 712,120 (53.4%)
- Organic search & store: 303,245 (22.7%)
- Paid (social + search): 155,144 (11.6%)
- Referral: 122,864 (9.2%)
- App links: 38,436 (2.9%)
- Other: 2,116 (0.2%)

Paid share of arrivals: 11.6% (Q2: 12.8%).

### Operating system (active students)

- Android: 1,027,248 (85.8%)
- Windows: 101,261 (8.5%)
- iOS: 44,518 (3.7%)
- Linux: 15,886 (1.3%)
- Macintosh: 7,387 (0.6%)
- Chrome OS: 1,160 (0.1%)

### Top cities (active students, share of quarterly total)

1. Dhaka: 353,337 (29.6%)
2. Chattogram: 110,460 (9.3%)
3. Rajshahi: 81,415 (6.8%)
4. Khulna: 54,991 (4.6%)
5. Sylhet: 34,051 (2.9%)
6. Rangpur: 32,203 (2.7%)
7. Mymensingh: 32,051 (2.7%)
8. Bogura: 30,438 (2.6%)
9. Cumilla: 30,052 (2.5%)
10. Jashore: 18,295 (1.5%)
11. Gazipur: 16,227 (1.4%)
12. Barishal: 15,604 (1.3%)

The top nine cities account for 63.7% of active students (Q2: 64.3%). Dhaka grew from 196K in Q2 to 353,337.

### Google Search (Search Console, web)

- Clicks: 1,326,484; impressions: 3,342,757; CTR 39.7%; mean daily average position 3.6.
- Peak day: Aug 15, 2026 - 32,368 clicks / 66,759 impressions. August total 569,963 clicks (July 334,469; September 422,052).
- 99.7% of clicks originate in Bangladesh. Device share of clicks: Mobile 69.3% (CTR 38.82%), Desktop 26.1% (CTR 40.4%), Tablet 4.6% (CTR 51.66%).

## 05 - CDN & Infrastructure (Apars CDN)

- Total delivered: 1.313 PB across 1.970 billion requests. Origin traffic 136.5 TB (10.4% of delivery). Mean daily cache hit rate 92.2%. Singapore PoP carries ≈99.4% of traffic.
- Daily delivery stepped from ~8 TB to ~20 TB from Aug 16 (Aug 15: 8.9 TB → Aug 16: 16.4 TB) and held for the rest of the quarter. Peak day 24.5 TB on Sep 15; peak requests 36.2M on Sep 29.
- Sep 29–30: a large share of the catalogue was re-fetched from origin (origin pulls ~2M → 13.8M/day, origin egress 7.8 TB, cache hit rate 61.9%); delivered bandwidth and requests were unaffected.

| Month | Bandwidth (TB) | Requests (M) | Cache hit rate | Avg origin response (ms) | Origin traffic (TB) | Origin share | Peak day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| July | 229.3 | 373.3 | 91.36% | 213 | 25.2 | 11.0% | 10.6 TB (Jul 28) |
| August | 435.8 | 650.5 | 93.54% | 225 | 37.7 | 8.7% | 22.7 TB (Aug 23) |
| September | 648.1 | 946.2 | 91.76% | 262 | 73.5 | 11.3% | 24.5 TB (Sep 15) |

### Secondary CDN (July 2026)

A second CDN is reported separately from the primary Apars CDN figures above. July 2026: 107.2 TB delivered over 140.7M requests; cached bytes 97.9 TB (91.3% of delivery); mean daily cache hit rate 87.9%; origin traffic 13.5 TB (12.6% of delivery) across 16.3M origin pulls; mean origin response 201 ms; peak day 5.1 TB on Jul 29. Errors: 17,198 5xx (0.012% of requests; 12,565 on Jul 8), 72,463 4xx, 1,549,680 3xx. Remaining months of the quarter will be added as their exports arrive.

## 06 - Quarter over Quarter (Q2 → Q3)

Monthly bandwidth (TB): Q2 429 / 355 / 273 → Q3 229 / 436 / 648.  
Monthly requests (M): Q2 762.0 / 609.8 / 452.3 → Q3 373.3 / 650.5 / 946.2.
Q2 figures are sourced from the Q2 2026 Performance Report (https://stats.asgshop.ai/2026/q2/).

## 07 - Key Insights

### Milestone: 609K monthly students - double the previous high
Rolling 30-day active students peaked at 608,723 on Sep 9, against 299K at the end of Q2. The quarter closed at 532K, still 78% above where it began.

### Signal: Aug 16: the admission cycle landed
Search clicks peaked on Aug 15, delivered bandwidth jumped 84% on Aug 16 and settled at nearly three times its July level, and the 30-day audience added 147K students in the following fortnight.

### Live: 311K live participants, 917 sessions
The Varsity 2026 batch alone drew 115K participants across 71 sessions (~1,600 per class); Rhombus Parallel ran 149 sessions, the most of any programme.

### Engagement: Three times the time on platform
Average engagement per active student rose from 18m 56s to 57m 05s.

### Content: Academic holds, Admission arrives
HSC Academic Program: 13.9M views, 19% bounce. Admission Special Private Programme: 9.1M views, 93K students within the quarter.

### Acquisition: Growth was earned, not bought
Paid channels fell to 11.6% of arrivals (from 12.8%) while new students rose 84%. Direct and organic search carried 76% of first visits; 1.33M Google clicks at 39.7% CTR, almost entirely branded queries.

### Reach: Dhaka 353K - and 64% from nine cities
Dhaka grew 80% to 353K, yet its share barely moved; Chattogram (110K), Rajshahi (81K), Khulna (55K) and the rest of the top nine grew in step.

### Scale: 1.97 billion requests, 92.2% from cache
1.31 PB delivered - 24% more than Q2 - for an audience 86% larger. Cache hit rate held at 92.2%, reaching 96% at the August peak; September alone delivered 648 TB, a monthly record.

## 08 - Recognition

In July 2026, TIME and Statista named Apars Classroom in the World's Top EdTech Companies 2026 ranking - a select group of 350 companies worldwide, recognised for strong financial performance and meaningful impact on the global education ecosystem. The evaluation covered financial strength (revenue, funding, market position), industry impact (SDG alignment, product effectiveness), innovation (intellectual-property portfolio) and market relevance (visibility, user engagement). Inclusion was confirmed in a letter dated 22 July 2026 signed by Jessica Sibley (CEO, TIME) and Marc Berg (CEO, Statista); the certificate and letter are shown at https://stats.asgshop.ai/2026/q3/#awards
